value.rationale: The primary mathematical gap is which diversity scales sustain majority-like cycling in many-opinion deterministic networks. Exact all-size basin populations and an explicit reentrant two-cycle regime show a sharp positive birthday peak, a rigorous intermediate vanishing phase and a later fixed-palette revival, with a unique balanced-scale optimizer. This is a natural nonlinear dynamical observable not supplied by generic period bounds or standalone occupancy statistics. This finding claims neither arbitrary-graph generality nor a global optimum outside the birthday window.
